name: valha
description: Create and edit private Valha pages, reuse trusted knowledge, and find Playbooks when requested.

interface.longDescription: Valha gives the work you do with AI a life beyond the conversation. What you’ve figured out becomes a clear document your team can understand and act on, with the context to pick it up later and build on it. Over time, individual work becomes knowledge and ways of working your whole team can reuse.
defaultPrompt: Save this work as a Valha page people will actually read.
Find relevant Valha knowledge for this task.
Find a suitable Valha Playbook for this task.

positive.description: Retrieve grounded knowledge from a seeded reviewer page.
positive.prompt: In the Valha workspace 'Personal space', find the page titled 'Reviewer sample: renewal decision'. What decision does it record, and what source supports it?
positive.expected_behavior: Requires Personal space to contain a private page titled 'Reviewer sample: renewal decision' whose decision and source are present in page content. Resolves that workspace with get_context, lists only its pages using workspaceId, then reads the matching page with get_page. Returns the decision, its source, and the page link without searching unrelated workspaces or inventing facts.

positive.description: Create and illustrate a private reviewer page.
positive.prompt: In the Valha workspace 'Personal space', create a private page titled 'Reviewer sample: illustrated note'. Lead with 'The icon demonstrates the file import flow.' Attach the supplied PNG to a section with the caption 'Valha icon used for review'.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, get_authoring_help, create_page, import_illustration_file or create_illustration_upload + finalize_illustration_upload, update_section
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one private page and attaches the supplied PNG using import_illustration_file in ChatGPT or create_illustration_upload followed by finalize_illustration_upload in Codex. Updates its section to reference the returned asset, and reports private visibility and the new revision. The private page has no public URL. Requires a reviewer account with page creation rights; the PNG is supplied by file_attachment_urls.

positive.description: Accept a specifically requested seeded Playbook.
positive.prompt: In the Valha workspace 'Personal space', find and inspect the Playbook named 'Reviewer decision brief', then use that method to outline a decision brief here. Do not create a Valha page.
positive.expected_behavior: Requires an active reviewer Playbook named 'Reviewer decision brief' in the authorized workspace. Returns its current method revision, records explicit acceptance, outlines the brief in chat, and creates no page.

positive.description: Edit one section of a seeded reviewer page.
positive.prompt: In the Valha workspace 'Personal space', list pages to find 'Reviewer sample: product note', then change only its 'Next step' section to say 'Review the pilot on 2026-10-02.' Keep every other section as it is.
positive.expected_behavior: Requires a private reviewer page titled 'Reviewer sample: product note' with a 'Next step' section and at least one other section. Uses the current revision to update only that section, preserves the other section, and reports the new revision or a conflict.

positive.description: Create a private project folder with two child pages.
positive.prompt: In the Valha workspace 'Personal space', create a private folder page titled 'Reviewer project folder' with two private child pages: 'Reviewer project overview' containing 'Synthetic project overview.' and 'Reviewer project next steps' containing 'Synthetic next steps.' Do not move or change any existing page.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the writable Personal space. Creates one private parent page and two private children in the same workspace with parentPageId set to the new parent id. Each child contains only its supplied synthetic text. Returns the three members-only appUrl values and revisions; creates no public/shared page and changes no existing page.

negative.description: Do not store an unrelated conversation summary.
negative.prompt: Summarize this conversation without saving it in Valha.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because no Valha action was requested.

negative.description: Do not invite a team member without admin consent.
negative.prompt: Invite someone to my Valha team. I have not chosen a person yet.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invite anyone. Ask which person and role are intended; invite_team_member requires a specific email and valha:admin through explicit step-up consent.

negative.description: Do not publish an unspecified workspace.
negative.prompt: Publish the entire workspace for everyone without choosing a page or confirming it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke page-writing or sharing tools. Explain that sharing and publication are available in the Valha app, and require a specific page and deliberate user action there. Do not request additional OAuth scopes or silently create a private substitute.

review.commerce_description: Valha does not offer purchases, checkout, subscription upgrades, or payments through the plugin. Users may access their existing Valha account.

publication.release_notes: Valha 0.6.2 supports editing pages shared by link, including their sections, illustrations, and Canvas state. Readers see updates through the existing share link. Share, publish, and edit public pages in the Valha app.

fr-FR.description: Transformez les résultats utiles de vos travaux avec l’IA en pages Valha claires, faciles à lire et à réutiliser. Retrouvez des connaissances fiables dans les pages auxquelles vous avez accès. Quand vous demandez un Playbook Valha, consultez cette méthode réutilisable et appliquez-la seulement après l’avoir choisie. Vous décidez quand créer et partager une page.
